title: Ulyana and the Cipher
author: Petra Sandoval
blurb: Oscar Reyes, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
